app.das_ihkberichtsheft_endet_am_31: The IHK report book ends on 31 December 2026
app.bundesweit_fuer_alle_kammern_ohne: Nationwide, for every chamber, with no successor from the IHK. Anyone keeping their report book there has to export it as a PDF beforehand — from 1 January 2027 there is no access. This page says what to do, and how the export carries on in MyWorkLog.
app.myworklog_ist_unabhaengig_kein_angebot: MyWorkLog is independent: not an IHK service, no agreement with any chamber. Free, offline, and your data stays on your device.
app.im_serviceportal_anmelden: Sign in to the service portal
app.kachel_berichtsheftverwaltung_oeffnen_da: Open the tile “Berichtsheftverwaltung”, then choose “Berichtsheft herunterladen” and “Berichtsheftexport aller Einträge”.
app.die_pdf_an_zwei_orten: Keep the PDF in two places, say on your device and in a cloud folder or on a USB stick. It is your proof for the final exam — even if you never continue the report book digitally.
app.entscheiden_wie_es_weitergeht_auf: Decide how to carry on: on paper, with your chamber’s template, or in a digital report book. How the export lands in MyWorkLog is explained further down.
app.wer_nach_dem_export_noch: If you add more weeks in the portal after exporting, simply export again — the PDF always contains everything up to that moment.
app.azubis_jetzt_informieren_die_kammern: Tell your apprentices now. The chambers explicitly ask employers to do so.
app.den_export_kann_nur_der: Only the apprentice can trigger the export. Set a date and file the PDF together — at the company and with the apprentice.
app.festlegen_wie_ab_januar_gefuehrt: Decide how the report book is kept from January: paper, semi-digital or digital. All three are permitted under the BIBB recommendation of 2020.
app.ob_die_eigene_ihk_eine: Whether your own IHK offers a successor varies from chamber to chamber: Magdeburg provides Azubiheft, Ostwürttemberg is not allowed to recommend anything for legal reasons. Your own IHK knows what applies.
app.die_freigabe_braucht_keine_ihk: Approval does not need the IHK. In MyWorkLog, a trainer with an account approves weeks with a digital signature, for all of the company’s apprentices in one place:
app.berichtshefte_pruefen_und_abzeichnen: review and sign off report books
app.myworklog_liest_die_pdf_aus: MyWorkLog reads the PDF from the service portal directly — every week, every day, the hours and the sign-off status. It happens in the browser on your device; the file is not sent anywhere.
app.ohne_konto_ohne_installation_der: — no account, no installation. The link opens the import straight away.
app.oben_in_der_werkzeugleiste_ihkpdf: In the toolbar at the top, choose “IHK-PDF Import”. The dialog “Import IHK export” opens.
app.die_datei_aus_dem_serviceportal: Drag the file from the service portal into the field or pick it. Reading takes a few seconds depending on its size.
app.oben_stehen_name_beruf_und: At the top: name, occupation and company from the cover sheet. Below it every recognised week with calendar week, date range, hours and status — “Reviewed & signed” or “Completed”. Weeks you already have are flagged and unticked; you decide what gets taken over.
app.wochen_importieren_fertig_die_wochen: “Import weeks” — done. The weeks carry the origin “IHK import”. A trainer with a MyWorkLog account sees them as “Signed off at the IHK” and gets no pending approval for them.
app.je_woche_zeitraum_kalenderwoche_ausbildu: Per week: date range, calendar week, year of training
app.tagesbasis_je_tag_taetigkeiten_mit: Daily basis — per day: activities as a list, hours, vocational-school day
app.wochenbasis_je_woche_der_freitext: Weekly basis — per week: the free text (split into school and company when the location is “Schule/Betrieb”), attendance, training hours
app.abwesenheiten_wie_urlaub_oder_krankheit: Absences such as holiday or sickness as a note
app.die_zuordnung_qualifikationen_ins_feld: The “Qualifikationen” mapping into the field Instruction & training
app.der_stand_bei_der_ihk: The status: signed off at the IHK or merely completed
app.name_beruf_betrieb_und_ausbildungsbeginn: Name, occupation, company and start of training into the PDF export details, if nothing is there yet
app.unterschriftsbilder_und_anhaenge_der_amt: Signature images and attachments. The official proof of sign-off remains the PDF itself — so keep it.
app.ab_hier_ist_es_ein: From here on it is an ordinary report book. Write daily or weekly, mark vocational-school days, complete the week at its end. For the exam, MyWorkLog produces the PDF on your chamber’s form — the DIHK template, Cologne and Frankfurt, Munich; other chambers get the DIHK template, and it says so.
app.links_kammer_und_vordruck_rechts: Chamber and form on the left, on the right the week exactly as it appears on the sheet — activities, instruction, vocational school, hours, signature fields.
app.die_freigabe_laeuft_ohne_kammer: Approval works without the chamber: the trainer creates an account, connects to the company and signs off weeks with a digital signature; the apprentice sees the decision in the report book. It also works without an account — a single week as a link to countersign. Both are described on the page
app.wer_auch_seine_arbeitszeit_erfassen: If you also want to track working hours, they are in the same tool: target hours, flexitime, overtime, leave. Hours from an Excel or CSV sheet can be taken over too —
app.myworklog_speichert_auf_deinem_geraet: MyWorkLog stores data on your device, in the browser. That is why it works without an account and offline — and the reason for this list:
app.an_zwei_orten_sie_ist: in two places. It is the proof you present at the exam, independent of any app.
app.nach_dem_import_in_der: after the import: in the app via Sidebar → Backup. A JSON file with everything, including the report book. Before every browser switch, reinstall, or “clear site data”.
app.im_selben_menue_dieselbe_datei: in the same menu: the same file, encrypted with a password (AES-256) — for cloud folders and shared computers.
app.optional_mit_konto_die_daten: optional, with an account: the data is additionally kept on a server in the EU and is available on every device.
app.in_den_einstellungen_holt_fruehere: in the settings: brings back earlier states the app itself kept in the browser — if something is missing, look there first.
app.was_ohne_backup_nicht_zurueckkommt: What does not come back without a backup:
app.werden_die_browserdaten_fuer_myworklogde: If the browser data for myworklog.de is deleted — clearing history with “site data”, reinstalling the browser, resetting the device — the local data is gone. No account, no server, so no copy anyone could hold for you. The PDF and a backup are the protection against that.
app.ist_myworklog_der_nachfolger_des: Is MyWorkLog the successor to the IHK report book?
app.nein_myworklog_hat_keinen_auftrag: No. MyWorkLog has no mandate and no agreement with any IHK. The chambers name no nationwide successor; some provide their own solution, others are not allowed to recommend one. Whether a report book may be kept electronically is set out in the training contract — that applies to every tool.
app.was_passiert_wenn_ich_bis: What happens if I have not exported by 31 December?
app.laut_den_kammern_ist_ab: According to the chambers there is no access from 1 January 2027, and no export after that. Whether an IHK can still help in an individual case we do not know — asking costs nothing. The only safe route is the one beforehand: export, file, carry on.
app.mein_ausbilder_hat_im_portal: My trainer signed off in the portal. Does that still count after the import?
app.der_import_uebernimmt_den_stand: The import takes the status from the PDF and marks the week as signed off at the IHK; a trainer with a MyWorkLog account sees exactly that. The official proof of sign-off, however, remains the PDF from the portal — keep it and be able to present it at the exam if anyone asks.
app.ich_habe_im_portal_wochenweise: I kept weekly entries in the portal, not daily ones.
app.beide_formen_werden_gelesen_tageweise: Both forms are read. Weeks kept day by day arrive with daily fields, weeks kept as a whole as one weekly text — split into school and company when the location is “Schule/Betrieb”, with attendance and hours. The weekly import was built from the portal’s manual; if something lands in the wrong place for you, send the page as text to info@myworklog.de and it will be adjusted.
app.nein_berichtsheft_und_import_laufen: No. Report book and import run without an account, on your device, offline too. An account is needed for two things only: syncing between several devices and connecting to the company so the trainer can approve.
app.nichts_auch_nicht_fuer_betriebe: Nothing, not for companies either. There are no plans and no advertising; the source code is open under the MIT licence.
app.erkennt_die_ihk_ein_berichtsheft: Does the IHK accept a report book from MyWorkLog?
app.zur_pruefung_verlangen_die_kammern: For the exam the chambers usually require a PDF; MyWorkLog produces it on the respective IHK’s form. Whether you may keep it electronically is governed by the training contract. When in doubt, ask your own IHK.
app.alle_angaben_zur_abschaltung_stammen: All statements about the shutdown come from the chambers themselves, read on 20 September 2026.
app.die_angaben_zu_myworklog_stammen: The statements about MyWorkLog come from the app itself and from the
app.ihk_und_serviceportal_bildung_sind: . “IHK” and “Serviceportal Bildung” are designations of the German Chambers of Industry and Commerce; MyWorkLog is not affiliated with them.
